reviewPacketOrReport.limitation: No complete editorial/critic review packet or local review UI.

humanAcceptanceRecord.limitation: No acceptance validator, immutable decision binding, or persistence workflow.

promotionValidator.limitation: Validation primitives exist, but no merged promotion transaction validator exists.

reviewQueueAssessment.inputContract: buildReviewQueue({ batchId, candidates }) using candidate.validationResults and optional proposedCuratedMovie/facts metadata
reviewQueueAssessment.currentScope: Generic validation-summary queue builder; existing generated use is semantic/factual readiness, not a complete editorial review transaction.
laterChanges: Add complete editorial and critic provenance.
Validate and persist explicit approve/revise/reject decisions.
Present compact reviewer-friendly evidence and poster context.
Bind accepted decisions to immutable candidate/artifact hashes.

pilotSelection.rule: Greedy set-cover over mood, spoken language, era, attention demand, emotional weight, discovery style, runtime band, and genre; ties break by candidateId.
